named: IPT MVPA minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity during the intervention program time period
result: Further, changes in the Generations Health group were significantly greater compared to the comparison group for minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity during the intervention program time (IPT MVPA) period.
second_look: Further, changes in the Generations Health group were significantly greater compared to the comparison group for minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity during the intervention program time (IPT MVPA) period. These findings translated into children in the Generations Health group engaging in 9 more minutes of IPT MVPA during a 40-min period compared to baseline and the difference in IPT MVPA between groups was significant (P = 0.028).
